concurrency_and_state: ConsignShopManager uses two ReentrantLocks (saveLock, listLock) and AtomicInteger nextItemId; however, async DB writers (updateItemBoughtAsync, deleteItemAsync, updateItemUpTopAsync, insertItemAsync) spawn unmanaged Virtual Threads without saveLock, racing against save() DELETE+INSERT.

ConsignShopService.getItemBuy(Player, int) and getItemCanKiGui(Player) iterate ConsignShopManager.listItem without acquiring listLock or using getItemsSnapshot(), risking ConcurrentModificationException.
ConsignShopService.buyItem holds the global ConsignShopManager.listLock across inventory copies, bag additions, DB async updates, and openShopKyGui network writes.
CombineService.startCombine and startCombineVip synchronize on player, whereas CombineService.showInfoCombine and openTabCombine mutate player.combineNew without synchronization.
CombineService.gI(), BuyBackService.gI(), and EffectMapService.gI() use unsynchronized lazy singleton initialization.
cross_module_questions: Where is ConstNpc.UP_TOP_ITEM handled in NPC menu routing, and does the caller set idMark.setIdItemUpTop before/after ConsignShopService.upItemToTop since upItemToTop does not store the consign item id?

What is the authoritative meaning of item option ID 230 in item_option_template — CuongHoaLoSao/EpSaoTrangBi treat 230 as 8th star-slot strengthening (starvip=1), whereas ChuyenHoaBangNgoc/ChuyenHoaBangVang treat 230 as downgrade count (soLanRotCap)?

Does PlayerDAO.updatePlayerAsync serialize itemsBag and itemsDaBan atomically, and how is CombineService.startCombineVip invoked from the network Controller (is n validated/clamped before reaching startCombineVip)?
In ShopService, is BuyBackService.addItem called inside synchronized(player), and how does ShopService handle TabShopHocKyNang?

db_redis_touchpoints.op: DELETE FROM shop_ky_gui + batched INSERT INTO shop_ky_gui(...)
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Uses try-with-resources and manual transaction (autoCommit=false), but lacks rollback() on error, un-backticked table/columns, skips save when itemsToSave is empty leaving stale DB rows, and races with async Virtual Thread SQL ops that do not acquire saveLock.

db_redis_touchpoints.op: SELECT shop_ky_gui.*, player.name AS player_name FROM shop_ky_gui LEFT JOIN player ... ORDER BY shop_ky_gui.created_at ASC
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Uses try-with-resources; un-backticked table/column names; sets nextItemId via max(id) of active rows only.

db_redis_touchpoints.op: Virtual Thread async UPDATE isBuy=1 / DELETE / UPDATE isUpTop / INSERT INTO shop_ky_gui
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Uses try-with-resources and backticked identifiers, but spawns unqueued Virtual Threads per call with no ordering guarantee (delete can overtake insert) and no saveLock coordination.
Uses try-with-resources; falls back to in-memory nextItemId on SQL exception and still adds item to listItem, causing memory/DB divergence.

db_redis_touchpoints.op: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) as max_id FROM shop_ky_gui
INSERT INTO shop_ky_gui(..., RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS) with commit/rollback
db_redis_touchpoints.safety_note: Uses try-with-resources and explicit rollback on error, restoring autoCommit=true in finally.

findings.impact: Consigned items, purchases, or cancellations can be lost, resurrected, or fail with duplicate key errors during periodic save().
findings.root_cause: save() deletes all rows from shop_ky_gui and re-inserts a snapshot under saveLock, while async Virtual Thread methods (updateItemBoughtAsync, deleteItemAsync, updateItemUpTopAsync, insertItemAsync) execute concurrent SQL writes without acquiring saveLock. Also save() skips deleting DB rows when itemsToSave is empty.
findings.title: Race condition and data loss between ConsignShopManager.save() and async Virtual Thread DB writes

findings.impact: Once shop_ky_gui.id exceeds 32767, clients receive truncated/negative item IDs and cannot buy/claim items; older/newer clients or >127 items in tab 4 suffer EOFException/stream desync.
findings.root_cause: openShopKyGui writes 32-bit int itk.id via writeShort(itk.id), writes list sizes via writeByte without clamping (>127 overflows), skips null items after writing header count, and openShopKyGui(Player) omits the version>=222 check for quantity and adds an extra newItem byte compared to openShopKyGui(Player, byte, int).
findings.title: Consign shop protocol ID truncation (writeShort on int id), byte count overflow, and version desync in openShopKyGui

findings.impact: Server-side bypass of upgrade/restriction checks: players can convert already-upgraded/socketed equipment, bypass Nâng cấp 10% failure rate for 100% success, upgrade max-tier books into arbitrary item IDs, or consign untradable (opt 30) items.
findings.root_cause: Execution methods omit validation present in showInfoCombine: ChuyenHoaBangNgoc/Vang do not check option 72/102 on trangBiCanChuyenHoa; NangCapSachTuyetKi does not restrict template IDs (1181-1183) or roll the 10% chance; ConsignShopService.itemCanConsign returns true for type 14/15 or opt 86/87 before checking opt 30 (making opt 30 check dead code).
findings.title: Missing server-side validation in combine execution and dead opt-30 trade lock check in ConsignShopService

findings.impact: Client sending a large n to startCombineVip(PHA_LE_HOA_TRANG_BI) can stall a Netty worker thread (holding player lock) for hundreds of millions of loop iterations, or hang infinitely if star is out of bounds (goldCost=0, gemCost=0).
findings.root_cause: startCombineVip passes arbitrary n to phaLeHoa without validating against {1, 5, 10} or player.combineNew.quantities, and phaLeHoa loops maxAttempts times synchronously with no upper bound.
findings.title: Unbounded loop DoS in PhaLeHoaTrangBi.phaLeHoa via startCombineVip

findings.impact: Players lose gold, gems, and materials while receiving no output item when bag is full, or encounter NullPointerException crashes.
findings.root_cause: These combine handlers call InventoryService.addItemBag BEFORE subtracting source items and without checking getCountEmptyBag(player) > 0. NangCapSachTuyetKi line 53 also dereferences sachTuyetKy.template.id before its null check.
findings.title: Missing bag-space checks and item-add-before-remove causing item loss and NPE in multiple combine handlers

findings.impact: ConcurrentModificationException when players open consign shop/sell tab while another thread registers or cancels a consign item, or corrupted combine state when packets race.
findings.root_cause: ConsignShopService.getItemBuy(Player, int) and getItemCanKiGui(Player) iterate ConsignShopManager.listItem without listLock/snapshot. CombineService.showInfoCombine mutates player.combineNew without synchronized(player).
findings.title: Unsynchronized shared list traversal in ConsignShopService and unlocked combineNew mutation in CombineService.showInfoCombine

findings.impact: Unbounded heap growth over server uptime leading to OOM, as every distinct option name + param integer creates a permanent String cache entry.
findings.root_cause: ItemOption.OPTION_STRING is a static ConcurrentHashMap with computeIfAbsent(name + "#" + param + "#") and no size limit or eviction policy.
findings.title: Unbounded static ConcurrentHashMap cache memory leak in Item.ItemOption.OPTION_STRING

findings.impact: Client receives mismatched item count vs written slot bytes on REOPEN_TAB_COMBINE (-81) or truncated OPEN_TAB_COMBINE when npcChose is null, causing EOFException/UI corruption.
findings.root_cause: reOpenItemCombine writes itemsCombine.size() as the byte count header, then skips null or consumed items that are no longer in itemsBag without adjusting the count. openTabCombine omits npcChose.tempId if null.
findings.title: Protocol stream desync in CombineService.reOpenItemCombine and openTabCombine

findings.impact: Players can re-strengthen an already-strengthened 8-star item if option 230 precedes option 107; ChuyenHoaBangNgoc/Vang misinterpret option 230 as downgrade penalty and corrupt/duplicate item options on conversion.
findings.root_cause: Option ID 230 has conflicting meanings across modules; CuongHoaLoSao overwrites checkOption=0 when option 107 appears after 230; ChuyenHoaBangNgoc/Vang copy all options from index 1..n of trangBiGoc onto trangBiCanChuyenHoa without filtering base stats or duplicate option IDs.
findings.title: Conflicting option 230 semantics, option-order bug in CuongHoaLoSao, and option corruption in ChuyenHoaBangNgoc/Vang

findings.impact: TaySach never reduces option 225 (luotTay) when decrementing option 232 instead; PhucHoiSach advertises 10M gold but charges 200M gold; CuongHoaLoSao advertises 100% rate but uses 35%; NangCapVatPham NPEs if item lacks base stat option and is missing from startCombineVip; NangCapSaoPhaLe/DoiDoThan lack showInfoCombine cases in CombineService.
findings.root_cause: Mismatched UI text vs execution parameters, missing switch cases in CombineService.showInfoCombine and startCombineVip, and unguarded option null dereference.
findings.title: UI/cost/rate mismatches, TaySach wrong option ID, and missing CombineService routing cases

findings.impact: ConsignShopService.KiGui duplicate listing check fails for items with options because ItemOption does not override equals(). ConsignShopService.claimOrDel action 2 casts gemSell long to int and ignores gem limits; BuyBackService.addItem NPEs if tagNameShop is null.
findings.root_cause: Item.ItemOption lacks equals()/hashCode(), and getTagNameShop() is not null-checked before .equals().
findings.title: Broken duplicate consign item check (ItemOption.equals) and potential NPE in BuyBackService

findings.impact: ItemTime.update() recalculates and sends full player stats multiple times in a single tick when multiple buffs expire simultaneously; Item.getInfo/getInfoItem concatenate Strings in loops.
findings.root_cause: Each expired buff branch directly invokes Service.gI().point(player) instead of setting a boolean dirty flag to recalculate once at the end of update().
findings.title: Redundant Service.point(player) recalculations in ItemTime.update() and String concatenation in Item.java

key_classes.name: ConsignShopManager
key_classes.responsibility: Singleton manager holding in-memory consignment shop list, locks, ID sequence, and MySQL persistence/async updates for shop_ky_gui.

key_classes.name: ConsignShopService
key_classes.responsibility: Handles player consignment listing, purchasing, cancellation, payout claiming with 10% fee, and shop packet serialization.

key_classes.name: CombineService
key_classes.responsibility: Central router and network message (-81) handler dispatching all item combination/upgrade operations for Ba Hat Mit, Whis, and Shop New.

key_classes.name: Combine Handlers (PhaLeHoaTrangBi, NangCapVatPham, EpSaoTrangBi, etc.)
key_classes.responsibility: Individual combine recipes validating materials, gold/gems, success rates, and mutating/creating player equipment, books, star gems, and earrings.

key_classes.name: Item & ItemOption
key_classes.responsibility: Core item instance and option model with template checks, option manipulation, and cached option string formatting.

key_classes.name: ItemTime
key_classes.responsibility: Tracks active timed consumable buffs, radar, auto-play, and power limit timers per player and clears expired buffs on tick.

key_classes.name: Shop / TabShop / TabShopHocKyNang / ItemShop
key_classes.responsibility: NPC shop data hierarchy, gender/skill filtering for shop tabs, and copy constructors per player.

key_classes.name: BuyBackService
key_classes.responsibility: Maintains up to 100 sold items per player in itemsDaBan for shop buyback.

key_classes.name: EffectMapService
key_classes.responsibility: Broadcasts map visual effect packets (opcode 113) to players in a zone.

module_summary: Read all 33 assigned files (5,819 lines) covering the consignment shop (ConsignShopManager, ConsignShopService, ConsignItem), item combination/upgrade system (CombineService, Combine, and 18 combine recipe classes), item & buff models (Item, ItemTime), NPC shop models (Shop, TabShop, TabShopHocKyNang, ItemShop), and helper services (BuyBackService, EffectMapService). Key risks center on consign shop DB/memory synchronization races, consign protocol ID/size truncation, missing server-side validation and unbounded loops in combine handlers, and conflicting option/bag-space handling across upgrades.

byte(2), byte(5 tabs), per tab: UTF(name), byte(totalPages), byte(count), per item: short(itemId), short(id), int(goldSell), int(gemSell), byte(buyType), int(quantity), byte(isMe), opts, byte(0), byte(0), optional UTF(playerName if version>=237)
byte(loop), byte(layer), byte(id), short(x), short(y), short(delay)
